name: whatsapp-clinic-bot
description: WhatsApp clinic receptionist bot — n8n workflows, DB schema, and support scripts (Spec MVP).

scripts.test: node scripts/test/validate.mjs && node scripts/test/sql.mjs && node scripts/test/appointments.mjs
scripts.seed-appts: node -e "import('pg').then(async({default:pg})=>{const fs=await import('node:fs/promises');const c=new pg.Client({connectionString:process.env.DATABASE_URL||'postgres://postgres:'+(process.env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD||'devpassword')+'@localhost:5433/'+(process.env.POSTGRES_DB||'clinic')});await c.connect();await c.query(await fs.readFile('db/seed-appointments.sql','utf8'));await c.end();console.log('seeded demo appointments')})"
